manifest.description: Player ship: a wooden two-masted brig. Oak hull with a raised stern castle (lit brass lanterns), forecastle, bowsprit. Square sails braced to catch the wind on both masts, a jib to the bowsprit, red pennants. Top-down 3/4 view, no water (it sits on a moving sea). 8 headings; the pennants flutter in the "sail" animation.
